name: Quilting
description: Quilting word search puzzles gather patchwork and sewing-room English for adults and seniors — block, batting, binding, fabric, pattern, border and quiet craft words — without quilt-shop or pattern-company brands. Play free online with easy, medium, hard and large print. No account and no timer: just the calm vocabulary of evening piecing and afternoon guild tables. Short tools such as pin, iron and mat keep beginners moving; longer anchors like binding, batting and pattern steady harder boards. Pair with Knitting and Sewing when you want a wider handmade hour, or open Large Print if tired eyes need bigger letters after a long project row. Written for grown-up crafters, not for licensed cartoon kits.
